problem_statement:
Fix transaction-context behavior in dataset.Database.

When an exception leaves a transaction scope, writes made inside that scope can be kept instead of discarded.

Successful transaction scopes should keep their writes. Failed scopes should leave previously committed data unchanged and propagate the original failure. A failed commit should also leave the transaction cleaned up, so later operations and connection cleanup remain usable.
